inferential_policy: Descriptive robustness and window-level resampling only; not a formal significance test and not a classifier-performance claim.
diagonal_policy: Reported kernels retain measured diagonal; unit-diagonal calculations are sensitivity checks only.
notes: Scalar off-diagonal metrics use directed i != j entries.
Directed-vs-unique off-diagonal equivalence is checked for symmetric kernels.
Paired contrasts include M1-M0, M2-M1, and M2-M0.
Leave-one-window-out jackknife rows include spearman, pearson, mae, cka, and kta_centered.
